title: Deprecate `ServerState` in the main module
description: This is mainly to not worry about it in the future.
patch_diff:
diff --git a/uvicorn/main.py b/uvicorn/main.py
index d9625fb03..afa4be0f1 100644
--- a/uvicorn/main.py
+++ b/uvicorn/main.py
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@
 import platform
 import ssl
 import sys
+import warnings
 from configparser import RawConfigParser
 from typing import IO, Any, Callable
 
@@ -29,7 +30,7 @@
     LoopSetupType,
     WSProtocolType,
 )
-from uvicorn.server import Server, ServerState  # noqa: F401  # Used to be defined here.
+from uvicorn.server import Server
 from uvicorn.supervisors import ChangeReload, Multiprocess
 
 LEVEL_CHOICES = click.Choice(list(LOG_LEVELS.keys()))
@@ -587,5 +588,17 @@ def run(
         sys.exit(STARTUP_FAILURE)
 
 
+def __getattr__(name: str) -> Any:
+    if name == "ServerState":
+        warnings.warn(
+            "uvicorn.main.ServerState is deprecated, use uvicorn.server.ServerState instead.",
+            DeprecationWarning,
+        )
+        from uvicorn.server import ServerState
+
+        return ServerState
+    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__} has no attribute {name}")
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     main()  # pragma: no cover
